Preregistration — earworm-continuous-isolated-voice-v1

Frozen execution revision `d50e24a6e0e847b4099a1ac05971dea7a5d6bbba`; no heldout waveform generated/exposed.
Protocol SHA256 `a258be4b360a865fd963f5c488b36e1af112e699fcc781b2d3cf7a00ae214681`.
Freeze SHA256 `40dc57738f74ccf4f136ed1bac66b89c68b9884b47497a0dbddad89166de1455`.
Execution code SHA256 `ddc336a6f9185d43cd20e40be1b9fcfbf39c0d3aea317cdc2235373248562515`.
Model SHA256 `de93e84686db8dd38504dc937dd313e3900b607a32ba855fdc109def4c7acd63`.

40 fresh normalized motif groups, 8/8/24 splits; 352 development/calibration streams including probes used, 528 reserved for evaluation (880 total). Fixed64ms contiguous chunks, <=32 chunks and <2s arrived prefix. Selected boundary b2:1.25-semitone change,2 confirmations; accepted NSDF/config and primary PR8 retrieval unchanged. Calibration selects/fits nothing. Oracle boundaries remain exclusively evaluator-side; fixed-window and all strong baselines share each front's events.

Scoring and branch rules frozen in `experiments/continuous-isolated-voice-v1/protocol.json`, `events.py`, `analyze.py`: time-only event correspondence with25ms bounds; explicit160ms latency;5000 group resamples seed2026092030, four-comparison Bonferroni intervals. Boundary-window diagnostic finalized before evaluation: oracle pitch accuracy>=.95, stream<.95 and >=90% incorrect matched windows having changed bounds can support B even when coarse timing F1 is high. No operational parameters changed after development. Extra pre-evaluation instrumentation records computation timestamps and chunk dispatch/response bounds, preserving retrospective-boundary versus availability distinction.

Declare remaining aids/aliases: synthetic stitched monophonic waveform (phase-reset joins), long motif separators, trailing evidence silence, fractional-factorial aliases, no recent-buffer eviction. Exact source-unit byte inventory balance is checked; chunk multisets need not agree because reordered units cross chunk edges. One frozen evaluation, then one complete snapshot and stop for review. Finish-line steering will be included in the ordinary PROJECT_STATE update without expanding this experiment.
